notes.title: Release
notes.content:
Hi Folks.

After a long slog The Dark Tower has released!

This brings to an end the Qaedon saga that started with The Curse of Feldar Vale and continued into Mystery at Morgoth.

We would like to thank everyone for their support, help with feedback, and encouragement. We couldn't have done it without you!

All the Best.

Ian & Jann
